title: Movie Dialogue where characters fail to say something clever

commenti.body:
- You're a real comedian.

- Well, they call me the Joker. 

- Well, I got a joke for you. I'm gonna tear you a new asshole. 

- Well, pilgrim, only after you eat the peanuts out of my shit.

- You talk the talk. Do you walk the walk? 

- ...

  
It works so well because up till this point, Joker has, in fact, not walked the walk. He gave up on Pyle, he stood idly by (understandably so) during the latter's final confrontation with the drill sergeant, he's a war correspondant but not accepted as one of the boys. He can joke, he's witty, but he's yet to gain his stripes and this short exchange illustrates that fact humourously (until, of course, a few scenes later).
